login.title: Console Login
login.hero_title: Sign in to use one assistant for answers and controlled execution
login.hero_desc: The console exposes only one AI assistant. It searches the manual and the safe repository knowledge base together, prepares previews first, and only commits allowed actions after confirmation.
login.card_help_desc: Learn the login flow, citation format, preview/commit workflow, and permission boundary.
login.card_manual_desc: The full manual includes examples, parameters, troubleshooting, and permission notes.

help.title: Help Center
help.quick_start_intro: Log in first, then use the single assistant in the bottom-right corner. If you want to modify a provider or a safe runtime config, ask for a preview first.
help.login_desc: The console uses a server-side session. The default admin account is for local development only and should be overridden with environment variables.
help.assistant_desc: Each answer can cite both the manual and the codebase. Any write action is limited to a whitelist and must go through preview/commit.
help.preview_commit_step_1: Describe the goal, such as adding a provider or adjusting a safe runtime config field.
help.preview_commit_step_2: The assistant collects missing parameters and returns a preview summary, diff, and audit result.
help.preview_commit_step_3: Commit only after review; the executor accepts preview_id only, never raw natural language.
help.preview_commit_step_4: After commit, inspect the action record, provider revisions, and result summary.
help.example_prompt_1: 1. "Explain how the current provider page is really implemented."
help.example_prompt_2: 2. "Preview a browser provider named adspower-main, but keep it inactive."
help.example_prompt_3: 3. "Change payment_plan to team and show me the preview first."
help.boundary_item_1: Document Q&A and code search: available after login.
help.boundary_item_2: Provider CRUD and safe runtime config updates: elevated permissions required, always preview first.
help.boundary_item_3: Registration automation, browser/CDP, token extraction, payment/card/3DS: explain only, do not commit directly.
help.boundary_item_4: The assistant knowledge base excludes .env, databases, artifacts, screenshots, caches, and other high-risk files.
help.manual_box_title: Help page and usage manual stay aligned
help.manual_box_desc: Open the manual directly if you need the complete step-by-step guide, field explanations, or troubleshooting.
